definition.I: weighted union cross OR dup over all frozen C query weights
definition.cross: Existing CF proper-penetration segments within .005L; boundary points included
definition.dup: Existing interior C queries at least .01L from C open boundary, finite F surface within .005L and abs normal angle <=15 degrees; near-parallel proximity, NOT an exact duplicate/coplanar-overlap proof
definition.point_denominator: All 2048 fixed C samples and their total weight, including excluded-border samples in denominator
definition.shared: cross AND dup; avoid summing cross and dup without subtracting shared

scope: Two fixed familiar HALF conditions, SMALL_C200 vs CREF_C200, eight registered noises, RAW and POST
scope_limits: Saved dup vectors do not store the nearest qualifying free face, signed side or thickness. These records cannot separate a legitimate nearby underside from a redundant parallel seat without a new targeted geometry audit, which was not run.
The exact coplanar-pair classifier and exact duplicate-face count are separate from near-parallel dup coverage.
Cross coverage measures bands around witnessed penetration segments; it is not the fraction of free faces intersecting C.
Association with adoption gains is descriptive over the frozen noises, not proof that useful adoption causes intersections.
